احترموا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَمُوا (iḥtaramū) /iħ.ta.ra.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اُحْتُرِمُوا (uḥturimū) /uħ.tu.ri.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اِحْتَرِمُوا (iḥtarimū) /iħ.ta.ri.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
